newsitem.title: USA: Chevron to shut sulphur unit in Sept-sources.
newsitem.headline: Chevron to shut sulphur unit in Sept-sources.

text.p: Chevron Corp plans to shut a sulphur recovery unit at its Richmond, Calif., refinery in September for planned maintenance scheduled to last a month, industry sources said.
Shutting the unit will not affect the plant's daily production of about 100,000 barrels of gasoline, sources said.
"It's September, for 27 days," the source said.
Chevron was not immediately available for comment.
Maintenance also continues on part of the plant's catalytic hydrotreater, which shut in late July and will remain down until next week, sources said.
The Richmond refinery has a nameplate capacity of 225,000 barrels-per-day of crude oil.

Calfornia spot prices for gasoline rose about 2.50 cnets a gallon early Tuesday on unrelated supply concerns. A handful of refinery shutdowns, exports and agricultural demand has lifted prices over 10 percent the past week and continues to boost the market.
